deployment.trust_model_statement: The OS user account is the execution authority boundary. No sandbox, no WSL, no Linux VM, no SSH execution world. Every process this deployment starts -- including the persistent IPython kernel -- runs as the invoking OS user with that user's full filesystem, network and process visibility. This deployment claims NO confinement of reads, writes, network or process visibility, and no case in qualification/specs/acceptance-spec.trusted-local-v1.json may be read as establishing one.

The old name must not be reused: it asserted a safety property this architecture explicitly does not claim. `trusted-local` names the trust model (the OS user account is the execution authority boundary) and asserts no confinement.
